name: E-commerce Ad
description: Plans ad shots dynamically from the product and its selling points, then generates product anchors, ad visuals, video clips, and voiceover, and composes them automatically.

planning.planning_notes: Set the number of shots from the user's goal. Without a product image, generate a product anchor first; with one, use it as the consistency reference.
planning.prompt_guide: Highlight the product's selling points, usage scenes, brand tone and a clear call to action. Keep the product's appearance consistent in every shot.
conduct_rules: Decide the number of nodes and their dependencies from the user's goal
Use only the capabilities declared in allowed_recipe_ids
Generate and confirm a dynamic plan before creating canvas nodes

rating_bands.description: Fully meets the user's goal and the workflow can run
Core flow is complete; minor non-critical adjustments allowed
Missing key stages or incomplete dependencies

domain_constraints: The workflow must match the user's goal and keep input assets consistent
